parameters.name: AccessGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the permission group to be deleted.

parameters.name: FileSystemType
parameters.description:
The type of the file system.

Valid values:

*   standard (default): General-purpose NAS file system
*   extreme: Extreme NAS file system

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas delete-access-group --access-group-name vpc-test --file-system-type standard --region cn-hangzhou
